cases.expected_output: Winglets reduce induced drag by weakening the wingtip vortex - the spanwise flow that rolls up around the tip - which cuts the downwash behind the wing and tilts the lift vector forward, recovering some of the energy otherwise lost to the vortex. cases.input: What is fly-by-wire based on, and how does it differ from a purely mechanical control system?

In contrast, a purely mechanical control system operates using a collection of mechanical parts such as rods, cables, pulleys, and sometimes chains to transmit the forces of the flight deck controls directly to the control surfaces (page 4).
